name: price-tracker
description: A telegram bot which can track prices for amazon and flipkart products. (Soon more) — TypeScript rewrite with pluggable stores and egress providers.

NODE_ENV.description: Set to production for webhook-mode Telegram (no long polling).

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your telegram bot token. Get it from https://t.me/BotFather

API_KEY.description: Secret key required by every API route except the /bot webhook.

DB_URL.description: Mongo db database URL. Get it from https://cloud.mongodb.com

LIMIT.description: Maximum number of products one user can track.

EGRESS_CONFIG.description: JSON (or a path to a JSON file) describing egress pools and providers. Supports ${ENV_VAR} interpolation.

PROXY.description: Legacy: proxy URL used for scraping (http:// or socks5://). Shorthand for a single EGRESS_CONFIG proxy pool.

WORKER_URL.description: Legacy: Cloudflare Worker URL used for scraping.
